review_scope: pre-owner visual review of staged pilot candidate; production article assets were not changed
reference_conditioning: The approved board was supplied to the built-in imagegen tool. The tool does not expose whether it used the image for conditioning, so successful conditioning is unverified.

card_preview.readability: Hook text remains readable at the displayed card size.

realism.notes: The product scene reads as a commercial 3D render, but its integration into the card is weakened by a visible rectangular backdrop.

material_quality.notes: Corrugated cases and timber pallets have plausible material appearance at card size.

lighting.notes: The dark-teal studio treatment is in-family, but the frame-like backdrop does not blend into the deterministic composition.

composition.notes: The pallet loads occupy too little of the illustration area. The prompt preserved left-side negative space even though the deterministic renderer already reserves the card text area.

clutter.notes: A broad semi-transparent rectangular matte is visible behind the scene.

family_consistency.notes: Dark-teal palette and commercial subject treatment resemble the approved family, but the undersized scene and matte reduce consistency.

blog_card_readability.notes: Typography is readable, while the comparison subjects are too small to communicate the article hook clearly at 360 by 203 pixels.

required_corrections: Scale both pallet loads to fill most of the illustration canvas; do not reserve an internal left-side text area because the renderer supplies the card layout.
Produce clean transparency around the subjects with no rectangular studio backdrop, haze, or full-frame matte.
Keep both loads similarly sized and clearly separable at blog-card dimensions.
decision: Do not present as an owner-ready candidate. This review fails the current candidate; another generation is needed to test the targeted corrections.
